المفكرة
component.summary: Text editor with first-class Arabic, RTL and Markdown support
محرّر نصوص سريع بدعم متكامل للعربية واتجاه النص وMarkdown

description.p: A fast, minimal text editor for the Linux desktop, styled after the Windows 11 Notepad. The writing direction is resolved per document — automatically from the content, or explicitly right-to-left / left-to-right — so Arabic and English files each render correctly.

It opens very large files in chunks with progress and cancellation, saves atomically, speaks ten languages, and offers an optional live Markdown view that formats the text without ever changing a byte of the file.

ul.li: Tabs with sticky-note colours and a pin-on-top mode
Auto-pairing, smart indentation and word completion
Optional syntax highlighting for fourteen languages
Ten interface languages, with an Arabic typeface bundled
Live Markdown rendering that keeps the source untouched
